title.zh: WE2 控制台 · DeepSeek Harness 皮肤

description.en: An off-white and ink hard-sci-fi console skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: paper canvas, ink sidebar with inverted hover, ink code decks, a typing reasoning ticker, a centred approval dialog and a bezel HUD.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的对话页重绘成流浪地球式的米白 / 墨黑控制台：纸色画布、墨黑侧栏与反相悬停、墨黑代码舱、实时思考字幕、居中授权弹窗和边框 HUD。

description.en: Off-white / ink hard-sci-fi skin for the DSH web UI: paper canvas, ink sidebar, ink code decks, a live reasoning ticker, a centred approval dialog, and a bezel HUD.
description.zh: 米白 / 墨黑硬核科幻皮肤：纸色画布、墨黑侧栏、墨黑代码舱、实时思考字幕、居中授权弹窗与边框 HUD。
